tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Full-text search over the public frosh.org documentation, blog and product overview. Returns matching page slugs, titles, URLs and a short snippet. Use read_page with a slug to get the full text.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Return the full text of one public frosh.org page by slug (from list_pages or search_pages), e.g. "docs/quickstart" or "blog/data-ownership".

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every public frosh.org page this server can read (slug, title, section, URL), optionally filtered by section.

tools.name: about_frosh
tools.description: What Frosh is (private MediaWiki, cloud-hosted or local desktop app), key links, and how this public MCP differs from the local admin MCP in the froshwiki CLI.

tools.name: wiki_status
tools.description: Show your Frosh cloud wiki's status: URL, VM state, privacy mode, MediaWiki version and plan. Requires your Frosh API key (Authorization: Bearer frsh_...); only reaches the wiki that owns the key.

tools.name: wiki_page_list
tools.description: List page titles in your Frosh wiki. Requires your Frosh API key (Authorization: Bearer frsh_...); only reaches the wiki that owns the key.

tools.name: wiki_page_read
tools.description: Read one page of your Frosh wiki as wikitext (default) or HTML. Requires your Frosh API key (Authorization: Bearer frsh_...); only reaches the wiki that owns the key.

tools.name: wiki_page_search
tools.description: Full-text search of your Frosh wiki's pages. Requires your Frosh API key (Authorization: Bearer frsh_...); only reaches the wiki that owns the key.

tools.name: wiki_page_write
tools.description: Create a page, or REPLACE the full content of an existing page, in your Frosh wiki. Show the user the title and content and get their explicit approval first, then call with confirm: true. Not idempotent: each call makes a new revision.
